name: @ocs/asymmetric
//: Public-key cryptography. Seven tools: RSA (WebCrypto, since @noble has none), ECDSA, Ed25519 and ECDH (all @noble/curves), and the three FIPS post-quantum schemes ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA (@noble/post-quantum, chosen because it is pure ESM -- every other implementation available is a native addon or a WASM blob the desktop CSP forbids). The first family where key generation is an operation in its own right and where one tool has more than two operations.
